data.name: Haziq
data.gender_notes: Haziq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hazaj', meaning 'to glow' or 'to radiate'. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with the Prophet Muhammad PBUH, who was described as a 'light-giving, radiant moon' (Al-Quran 33:46). It is also a name of a companion of the Prophet, Haziq ibn Amr. The name Haziq carries the meaning “Glowing, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haziq usually hope their child will grow to embody glowing, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
